_doc: Classification layer for Claude usage accounts that are NOT in the Airtable Active roster. Airtable is the system of record for employees; this file is the system of record for everyone else who legitimately shows up in Claude billing. Keys are the usage (Claude Enterprise billing) email. classification: contractor | departed | leave | service. dmEligible gates ALL DM categories. reviewBy is a maintenance date, not an expiry - the pipeline warns when it passes.
